name: An Old History Book: the map and the in-world tracker both mark Milton Sheaf in the CoA Royal Library (#6444)
contract: Quest 337 'An Old History Book' is ended by Milton Sheaf 1440. CoA moved him (guid 8704) into the rebuilt Royal Library at (-8279.309, 226.965, 155.447) in rev_20260923_03_coa_stormwind.sql, but the turn-in marker still points at the stock library spot (-8346, 384), about 171 yd away. Quest 337 has three POIs: ids 0 and 1 (ObjectiveIndex 4, the book's drop areas in Duskwood, 7 and 5 points) and id 2 (ObjectiveIndex -1, the turn-in, Stormwind City WorldMapAreaId 301, one point). This case asks the server for 337's points with the CMSG_QUEST_POI_QUERY a real client sends and reads SMSG_QUEST_POI_QUERY_RESPONSE: the turn-in POI starts at byte 172 and its single point must be Milton's spot rounded to the grid (-8279, 227). The in-world arrow and minimap pin are a second route: the client resolves them from QuestSuperTrack.dbc row 2300 (quest 337), whose completion node is SuperTrack.dbc 607, shipped at the stock spot (-8346.0, 383.928, 122.274) and shared only with quests 343 and 542, which Milton also ends. The corrected node ships in the client data and is not observed here. These are data assertions: the harness cannot see what the client draws.
